Bryan (Support): acme-inc escalation — they hit repeated 400s when using our OpenAI-compatible function_call flow. Customer says model returns a tool call but our server-side schema validator rejects the args (enum/value mismatch). Sending logs and repro steps.

Maria P: can you paste the exact payload + response? also which model variant?

Bryan (Support): payload they send (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini-tooling",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Get user info for 12345"}],
  "functions": [{
    "name": "get_user",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {"type": "string"},
        "subject": {"type": "string", "enum": ["USER", "ORG"]}
      },
      "required": ["id", "subject"]
    }
  }],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

Bryan (Support): model response (excerpt):
```json
{
  "id": "resp-abc",
  "choices": [{
    "message": {
      "role": "tool",
      "name": "get_user",
      "content": "{\"id\":\"12345\",\"subject\":\"Person\"}"
    }
  }]
}
```

Bryan (Support): our validator errors with: `400 invalid_function_args: enum mismatch for property subject: expected one of [USER, ORG] got Person`

TJ: looks like the model returns a human-readable enum (Person) while their function schema expects machine enum (USER/ORG). This is an OpenAI-compat divergence — some models return display values instead of canonical enum tokens.

Maria P: is this happening only for that customer or other customers too? any quick repro on our sandbox?

Bryan (Support): only saw it reported by acme-inc so far. I repro'd locally against hosted proxy using their exact payload. Repro steps:
1) curl our endpoint with payload above
2) observe 200 from model proxy but 400 from /validate-function-args in our pipeline
3) validator stack: `ValidatorError -> EnumMismatch -> reject` (logs attached)

Alex W: low-effort mitigation: add a mapper that normalizes known display names to enum tokens before validation (e.g., Person -> USER). Need to know all affected functions though.

TJ: agree. Short-term patch: in function-call adapter, when a function schema has enum on a string property, treat model-provided values case-insensitively and attempt to map common display synonyms (Person -> USER, Organization -> ORG). I'll PR a small heuristic.

Maria P: long-term we should decide whether to accept display values by default or require models to honor canonical enum values. This affects safety / determinism. Put an option in config: `accept_display_enum_values: true|false` at org-level.

Bryan (Support): customer asked for ETA — can we do a hotfix? they'd like a quick bandaid on their Dedicated instance.

TJ: I can do a canary patch for dedicated clusters. Plan: add mapping layer + fallback. Risk low. If deploy OK, roll to other dedicated customers. I'll need an owner for QA.

Alex W: @TJ please coordinate with @Maria for config flag and @bot-deploy for canary. If you have a patch ready today we can schedule a 1-hour maintenance window.

bot-deploy: deploy pipeline triggered by TJ — deployment queued to staging and dedicated-acme cluster.

Maria P: QA checklist: reproduce with acme payload, ensure validation now accepts both canonical and display values when config enabled, run 1000 random enum fuzz tests, verify logs show normalization. Also update docs about OpenAI-compatible caveats.

Bryan (Support): I've told acme-inc we'll push a config patch and follow up with timeline by EOD. Ticket #5421 updated. cc: Customer Success. :thumbsup:

TJ: assigning to me and Maria. ETA for staging patch: 3h. Canary to dedicated-acme after tests: +1h. I'll post deploy link and logs here.

Alex W: Thanks team. If anything else pops up ping #eng-runtime directly.

bot-deploy: staging deploy succeeded (build 2026.17.3). Dedicated-acme canary deploy starting...

Bryan (Support): will share customer confirmation when canary is live.

Maria P: adding follow-up action item to backlog: implement `accept_display_enum_values` flag and document OpenAI tool-calling quirks.

TJ: canary live and passing validation for acme payload. closing escalation once acme confirms.

Bryan (Support): acme confirmed fix at 2025-11-10T14:37:20Z. resolving.
